educationalGoal:
Through aiming to enhance artistic problem-solving skills with intuitive and intuitive thinking accompanied by execution capabilities:
-be able to learn based dialogue on museum exhibition (exhibits/spaces) .
-be able to co-create knowledge with others who hold different values and perspectives.
advice: In the era of V.U.C.A. (Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity and Ambiguity), not only is scientific problem-solving emphasized, which relies on logical and rational thinking, but also artistic problem-solving, which depends on intuitive and sensory thinking, is required. In this course, we combine project-based learning focusing on the cultivation of cultural literacy within our living communities with museum learning involving visits to multiple museums from the region. To aim for the improvement of artistic  problem-solving skills through the combination of these two modes of learning in liberal arts education. The traditional museum learnings often focus on humanities fields such as art museums and historical museums, but what distinguishes liberal arts education at technical universities is the inclusion of museums in the field of technology. As one means to achieve the theme of the project, we incorporate the planning and implementation of liberal arts open lecture as a learning task.
requiredKnowledge: As the final outcome of the project activity, we will implement liberal arts open lectures for the general public. Therefore, we request enthusiastic participation in the project activity with responsibility until the course ends.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In the era of V.U.C.A. (Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity and Ambiguity), not only is scientific problem-solving emphasized, which relies on logical and rational thinking, but also artistic problem-solving, which depends on intuitive and sensory thinking, is required. In this course, we combine project-based learning focusing on the cultivation of cultural literacy within our living communities with museum learning involving visits to multiple museums from the region. To aim for the improvement of artistic  problem-solving skills through the combination of these two modes of learning in liberal arts education. The traditional museum learnings often focus on humanities fields such as art museums and historical museums, but what distinguishes liberal arts education at technical universities is the inclusion of museums in the field of technology. As one means to achieve the theme of the project, we incorporate the planning and implementation of liberal arts open lecture as a learning task.
